name: Pendulum Squat Machine
description: The pendulum squat machine places the lifter in an angled standing position on a swinging platform that moves in an arc rather than a straight vertical line. This pendulum arc naturally accommodates the body's mechanics during a squat, allowing a very upright torso and deep knee flexion. The machine is highly effective for quadriceps development with minimal lower back involvement.

execution.starting_position: Step onto the pendulum machine platform, position the shoulder pads over your traps, and stand upright. Feet shoulder-width apart.
execution.setup_instructions: Load the machine and step onto the platform. Lock the shoulder pads in place. Release the safety.
steps: Step 1: Brace and begin bending the knees, allowing the platform to swing in its arc.
Step 2: Descend to full depth — the arc mechanics allow an extremely upright torso.
Step 3: Drive through the feet to extend the knees and return the platform to the starting position.
Step 4: Engage the safety at the end of the set.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale before the descent, exhale on the drive.
safety_considerations: Engage safety handles after each set
Start with light load to understand the arc movement
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full depth — the machine accommodates it. Use the full arc.
coaching_cues: Let the machine arc guide you
